name: Singapore Map Open Data
description: Static JSON backend for the interactive Singapore map. Fetch over HTTPS; no key, no server. Snapshot dated Nov 2026.

endpoints.pois.json: 108 curated points of interest: {name, category, desc, lat, lng, address, postal}. Categories: attractions, museums, nature, food, worship, shopping, districts, transport, landmarks, beaches.
endpoints.rail-graph.json: MRT/LRT graph for routing: {adj: {stationName: [[toStation, lineCode, km], ...]}, nodes: {stationName: {lat, lng, codes}}}. 184 stations. Run Dijkstra with a 4-min transfer penalty and ~2.2 min/km to plan journeys or isochrones.
endpoints.phase2.json: {hawker[], libraries[], hospitals[], schools[], parks(GeoJSON), pcn(GeoJSON), choropleth{}}. choropleth is keyed by URA planning area name -> {pop, density, hdb, hdbN} (Census 2020 population; median HDB resale price last 24 months).
endpoints.tours.json: 5 walking tours: [{name, desc, km, stops:[{name, lat, lng, note}]}].
endpoints.sg-planning-areas.geojson: 55 URA planning areas (GeoJSON). properties: PLN_AREA_N, REGION_N, AREA_KM2, SUBZONE_CT.

caveats: Indicative boundaries; not for navigation or legal use.
